hub_identity.reservation_rule: Reserve the ticket (atomic O_EXCL create) before writing runners, artifacts, data, or logs. Existing IDs are rejected across registry, JSONL, tickets, logs, artifacts, data, and runners.

hypothesis: candidate_pool: 8-K filing text with explicit customer/supplier contract economics and numeric value or duration may identify durable demand events. Requiring same-day liquid SPY-relative leadership tests whether the market is starting to recognize that demand before next-open paper entry.

prediction.confidence_reason: Recent blockers explicitly require structured customer/supplier contract economics before more SEC text alpha. The archived SEC text covers all three fixed windows and can expose numeric value/duration without LLM. Prior generic SEC text and item-code attempts failed, so the edge must come from the stricter economics tuple plus price confirmation.

execution_envelope.liquidity_source: price >= $10 and ADV20 >= $50M from PIT OHLCV
execution_envelope.order_semantics: observe-only next-session-open paper entry; no broker order
execution_envelope.portfolio_displacement: none unless a later shared helper and activation gate pass
execution_envelope.kill_switch: trade_enabled remains false; no production adapter changes
execution_envelope.failure_handling: missing SEC filing text, missing explicit contract/customer/supplier language, missing numeric value/duration, stale or excluded financing/legal text, missing OHLCV, missing next open, or missing 10d exit rejects the paper candidate

production_impact.parity_note: This experiment changes no production code. A positive result is only a replay lead until a shared default-off helper parses the same SEC filing text fields, exclusion rules, value/duration extraction, same-day OHLCV confirmation, cooldown, next-open paper entry, 10-day exit, costs, and concentration controls in both historical replay and daily production.

post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: The SEC text contract-economics source did not clear Gate 4 (failed: aggregate_ev_not_positive, aggregate_pnl_not_positive, window_ev_regression, window_pnl_regression, fewer_than_two_ev_improved_windows, target_sample_too_small, target_concentration_failed, accepted_compression_ev_not_beaten, accepted_compression_pnl_not_beaten, accepted_distribution_ev_not_beaten, accepted_distribution_pnl_not_beaten). It is not retained or promoted.
post_run_reflection.outcome_summary: Aggregate EV delta -0.0391; aggregate PnL delta $-691.21; max drawdown drift +0.0016; 8 paper trades.
post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not retry by sweeping SEC contract phrase lists, value/duration thresholds, item codes, RS/close/volume/vol guards, top-N, hold days, cooldown, or notional on these frozen windows.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: A retry needs a materially richer structured event tuple, such as counterparty identity, contract duration/value normalization by market cap, source-document evidence spans, or closed forward replacement rows. Do not sweep regex phrase lists, value thresholds, item codes, RS/close/volume guards, top-N, hold, cooldown, or notional on these frozen windows.
